newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares add on, Wienerberger at year high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares add on, Wienerberger at year high.

text.p: Austrian shares shook off earlier losses to end with moderate gains on Thursday, with the market supported by highly selective buying interest.
"It was up and down like on a rollercoaster in certain stocks," said one trader.
Traders expect the market to continue treading water over the next few days. "It's above all important that we hold above 1,300 points on the ATX," said one trader.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips gained 2.75 points, or 0.21 percent, to 1,306.92 after earlier falling to a session low of 1,299.14.
Of its constituents, 13 advanced while eight fell.

The day's best performing stock was brick manufacturer Wienerberger, up 1.8 percent at a new high for the year at 2,545 schillings. The all-time closing high for Wienerberger is 2,686.67, recorded in July 1995.
Creditanstalt's preferred led the day's decliners, shedding 2.26 percent to 480.70 schillings.
Bank Austria lost eight schillings to 416 ahead of the announcement, expected later today, of the share price for the planned three billion schillings capital increase.
BWT, which is not included in the ATX but is continuously traded, surged over five percent to 1,762 after breaking tough resistance at 1,700.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index added on 0.9 points, or 0.19 percent, to 479.16.
In the futures market, the June ATX contract gained 10.5 points to 1,308.0 on turnover of 430 lots.
